name: Scaffold-Lab unconditional generation
description: Unified evaluation of protein backbone generation methods: 100 backbones per length group are refolded with ProteinMPNN and ESMFold and scored for designability, novelty, diversity and runtime.

attributes.task: Generate protein backbones unconditionally and evaluate them in a shared refolding pipeline
attributes.scope_note: Per group, 100 backbones with 10 ProteinMPNN sequences each are refolded; a backbone is designable if the refolded structure shares a TM-score above 0.5 with it. Short covers lengths 50 and 100, medium 200 to 500 and long 600 to 1000.
attributes.source_locator: Table 2 (length grouping), Table 3, and the Metrics section (designability, novelty, diversity, efficiency, ranking)
limitations: Methods are evaluated only at the lengths the authors could run them at, so the groups hold different method sets.

limitations: Table 3 only: the unconditional-generation summary. The motif-scaffolding results, the secondary-structure composition, the structural-validity checks and the dynamic-threshold analyses are figures and were not extracted.
Table 3 prints no unit for the efficiency column; the text says it is the average time to generate each backbone and that current methods take several minutes, so the unit is recorded as unreported.
The table prints group means without data preprocessing; the per-backbone values behind them are not published in the article.
The acknowledgements thank Brian L. Trippe, an author of FrameDiff, for contributing to the Scaffold-Lab codebase; he is not an author of this paper.

evidence_concerns.message: Table 3 Designability column: equation (1) defines a per-backbone success over 100 backbones per length, which gives two-decimal fractions, but the column prints three-decimal group means; the aggregation behind the column is not stated, and the criterion is sc-TM above 0.5, not the 2 Angstrom sc-RMSD in the store's designability concept. Do not compare these values with other designability results.
